124: They do not hold of that which was stated by Rav Yehuda - And we do not say Migu [one is believed due to not making an advantageous claim], because the situation implies that he [the creditor[ is a liar, [by the fact] that he said the document was lost, as this document is not comparable to a document of sale.[The prime purpose[ of a document of sale is evidence that the land was sold to him, do we expect (to say to) a person for evermore to keep (be careful) with it [the document], the Rabbis say with regard to this, up to three years a person can be careful, beyond that they are not, [because a man will say] no (further) contention has arisen, but in this [case] he acknowledges that it is a mortgage document, the [purpose of which] is to evidence the number of years of  consumption of produce, and to claim the rights to [actually] consume the produce during those (for a number of) years, and [a person] would be very careful that it should not get lost until the years are completed and [in this case] the claim it was lost is not believed, for [all] he has done is [just] suppress [the document]:
